info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Customer Bill Pay Switches-spec
info.description: This endpoint provides access to the Bill Pay switch settings for a specific customer. By using a customer ID, users can retrieve details about the customer's Bill Pay preferences, allowing for effective management of payment services. Typical consumers include customer support teams and account managers who need to view and manage Bill Pay configurations for their clients. This information is essential for ensuring that customers have appropriate payment options tailored to their needs.

get.summary: Retrieve bill pay switches for a specific customer.
get.description: This endpoint fetches the bill pay switches associated with the customer identified by the unique customer ID 'CUST-100045'. It provides details on the available bill pay options and their current status.
